correctness.rationale: For a single added line, every new K_{m,n} must contain that line; this occurs exactly when its neighborhood contains an m-set already lying on n-1 old lines. The realization construction uses n-1 private lines per hyperedge, so distinct m-edges cannot jointly create K_{m,n}. The graph-to-uniform-hypergraph gadget gives the exact identity i(H_m(G))=((2^(m-2))-1)2^|V|+i(G). Exhaustive finite replay agrees with all three steps.

value.rationale: The result identifies the complete generating function for all single-line extensions of every finite K_{m,n}-free incidence structure with a standard hypergraph invariant and proves converse universality. This transfers a large body of independence-polynomial phenomena into a canonical model-theoretic base class and gives a uniform #P-completeness theorem for all fixed m,n>=2, rather than an isolated computational example.
